verdicts.evidence: HEAD b9b8504c1b893dc73a25b46fe62382d59eb9cdf1, detached. Applied from worktree-agent-a19febfb0f4c5a241: packages/engine/test/bench/redteam-RT-11-big-values.bench.ts, redteam/rt11-p4/mutants/F9-generic-slow.patch, redteam/rt11-p4/bench-mutant.sh and redteam/rt11-p4/bench-compare.sh. I also applied redteam/rt11-p4/mutants/R-b85ac0f-search.patch, which bench-compare.sh reads by path. None of these exist at the gate commit. Finding 1's files stayed in place; they lie outside test/bench and the bench config includes only test/bench/**/*.bench.ts. I used the stated 'by hand' route. I did not run bench-mutant.sh, because by default it writes its log and TMPDIR into the lens's scratch directory (scratchpad/rt-11-p4/tmp, which exists), and changing that needs RT11_TMP, an added environment variable. Commands: patch -p1 < redteam/rt11-p4/mutants/F9-generic-slow.patch (exit 0). Then a scratch script that cds to packages/engine and runs exactly `npx vitest run --config test/bench/vitest.config.ts orbit.bench; echo exit=$?` and `npx vitest run --config test/bench/vitest.config.ts redteam-RT-11; echo exit=$?`. The run is timing-dependent, so it ran twice. Run 1 (load 7.18): 'orbit benchmark: median 9.59 ms of 7 runs [14.07, 9.59, 9.88, 10.46, 8.20, 9.45, 8.56] ms, threshold 25 ms', exit=0. 'RT-11 bench: seeds 0/1 (search on numbers) median 9.62 ms; seeds times 2^60 (Big arithmetic) median 315.58 ms [325.39, 311.37, 318.52, 315.58, 349.06, 312.53, 312.75]', then 'AssertionError: expected 315.58384200000023 to be less than or equal to 25', exit=1. Run 2 (load 6.45): orbit benchmark median 8.51 ms, exit=0. RT-11 bench: Big median 318.64 ms, 'expected 318.6385439999999 to be less than or equal to 25', exit=1. Then patch -R -p1 < redteam/rt11-p4/mutants/F9-generic-slow.patch (exit 0). Control on the unmutated tree (load 6.62): orbit benchmark median 4.19 ms, exit=0. RT-11 bench: seeds 0/1 median 6.20 ms, seeds times 2^60 median 25.07 ms [34.64, 25.28, 19.59, 27.07, 21.45, 25.07, 20.74], 'expected 25.07042799999988 to be less than or equal to 25', exit=1. Comparison: observed matches. Under F9 orbit.bench.ts stays green at 9.59 and 8.51 ms (finding: 11.11 and 7.84 ms). The bigint loop on the same board, cap 2000 and maxDepth 40 takes 315.58 and 318.64 ms (finding: 312.35 and 340.10 ms). That is about 12.6 times the unmutated bigint loop (25.07 ms) and about 33 times the orbit.bench median. The mutant effect (bigint loop slowed, benchmark still green) does not depend on load. The red-team bench's own exit=1 does depend on load: unmutated it failed narrowly at 25.07 ms, which matches the finding's note of 27.74 to 39.92 ms at load 11. Afterwards the tree held only the applied files, and search.ts was restored.
verdicts.reason: reproduced as stated; observed matches: with F9-generic-slow applied, orbit.bench.ts passes twice (median 9.59 and 8.51 ms, exit 0) while the same 2000-position search in the bigint loop (seeds times 2^60) takes 315.58 and 318.64 ms (unmutated 25.07 ms), so the SPEC 7.6 benchmark no longer times Big arithmetic
